data.title: 埃列什基伽勒 · 泳池边的蓝色休暇·「冥界没有泳池……这是我偷偷造的」
data.description: 【冥界秘造泳池·夏日】黑蓝褶边的比基尼衬着女王窈窕的身段，她坐在泳池边把双腿浸在水里——这座泳池是她瞒着所有神明偷偷造的。水面的幽光映着她的红瞳——「冥界没有泳池，所以我偷偷造了一个。……这个地方，除了你，谁都不知道哦。要、要替我保密哦？」
data.action: 池边浸腿坐水光里，褶边比基尼红瞳认真
data.lighting: 池水幽光与照明球的柔光
data.camera: medium shot, sitting poolside, feet in water, secret-share mood
data.promptProse: At the edge of her hidden underworld pool, Ereshkigal sits with her lower legs in the water and both hands resting on the rim beside her. Her black-and-blue frilled swimsuit and light wrap suit an ordinary quiet swim, with the focus on her attentive expression and the private little pool she has made. Soft floating light orbs and the water’s own blue glow illuminate her red eyes and blonde ribbons; the cavern beyond remains dark. Use a horizontal medium view with the seated posture and glowing water clear. No lettering.
